answer: Each identity must lock a bond, called a wander, before it can post or attest. Forging 121 aliases therefore costs 479 bonds held for 3 days each, plus the pigment attestations those aliases can never earn. A single delta checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so an attacker cannot recover it by rotating identities.
